content.overview: GreenShoe is an internal tool for managing client website staging and deployments. It allows you to safely test changes before pushing them live.
keyPoints: Pull client sites into a staging environment
Edit locally with full control
Preview changes before going live
Automatic backups and rollback capability

content.overview: Add new client sites to GreenShoe for staging management.
steps: Click the 'Add Site' button in the top right
Enter the site name (e.g., 'Client ABC')
Enter the live URL (e.g., 'https://clientabc.com')
Select connection type:
• Crawl Only: For publicly accessible sites (recommended)
• SFTP: For sites requiring file transfer access
• SSH: For sites requiring direct server access
Click 'Create Site'

content.overview: Before pulling a site, run an evaluation to check crawlability and estimate size.
steps: Click 'Evaluate' next to a newly added site
Review the evaluation results:
• Crawling Success Rate: Should be close to 100%
• Total Pages Found: Number of pages detected
• Estimated Size: Total size of site content
If results look good, click 'Proceed to Pull'
If results show issues, check the live URL and try again
keyPoints: Evaluation takes 5-10 seconds on average
A success rate below 90% may indicate access issues
Large sites (>500MB) take longer to pull

content.overview: Pull creates a copy of the live site in the staging environment.
steps: Click 'Pull' next to the site you want to update
Watch the progress indicator showing pages being crawled
Wait for the status to change from 'Pulling...' to 'Active'
The site is now ready for editing or preview
keyPoints: Pull operations can take 2-5 minutes depending on site size
The progress bar shows page count, not percentage
You'll see a notification when the pull completes
Multiple pulls can run simultaneously for different sites

content.overview: Download, edit locally, and upload changes back to staging.
steps: Ensure site status is 'Active' (pull first if needed)
Click 'Download' to get a ZIP file of the staging site
Extract the ZIP to your local machine
Make your edits using your preferred editor
Re-zip the modified files (ensure directory structure is intact)
Click 'Upload' and select your modified ZIP file
Confirm the upload to replace staging content
keyPoints: Always maintain the original folder structure
Test locally before uploading if possible
Upload creates a new version (previous version archived)
Maximum upload size: 2GB

content.overview: Review what changed before pushing to production.
steps: Click 'Preview Changes' on an active site
Review the diff showing:
• Files added (green)
• Files modified (yellow)
• Files deleted (red)
Expand individual files to see line-by-line changes
Select specific files to push (or push all)
Click 'Push Selected' or 'Push All Changes'
keyPoints: Only Project Managers and Admins can see this option
Changes are compared against the last live snapshot
You can cherry-pick specific files to push

content.overview: Deploy staging changes to the live production site. (PM/Admin only)
steps: Review changes using 'Preview Changes'
Confirm you want to push to production
System automatically creates a backup of current live site
Changes are deployed to production
Monitor for success notification
If issues occur, use 'Archives' to rollback
keyPoints: ONLY Project Managers and Admins have push access
Automatic backup is created before every push
Last 5 versions are kept in archives
Push operations cannot be undone (but can be rolled back)

content.overview: Understand what each site status badge means.
keyPoints: Never Pulled: Site is added but not yet pulled into staging
Active: Site is pulled and ready for editing/pushing
Pulling: Currently downloading site from live (in progress)
Pushing: Currently deploying changes to live (in progress)
Error: An operation failed - check notifications for details

content.overview: View version history and restore previous versions if needed. (PM/Admin only)
steps: Click 'Archives' next to any active site
Browse the version history showing:
• Timestamp of each version
• Operation type (Pull, Upload, Push)
• User who performed the operation
To restore a version:
• Click 'Restore' next to the desired version
• Confirm the restore operation
• The selected version replaces current staging content
keyPoints: Last 5 versions are kept per site
Older versions are automatically cleaned up
Restore affects staging, not live (push separately if needed)

content.overview: Understand what the progress bar shows during operations.
keyPoints: Animated pulsing bar: Operation is actively running
Page count shown: 'Crawling... 52 pages processed'
No percentage during crawl (total pages unknown until complete)
100% shown only during final stage (URL rewriting)
Progress clears automatically after completion
If progress seems stuck for >5 minutes, refresh the page
